title: 宿舍楼顶的小菜园
summary_zh: 去年春天，宿舍楼的同学在楼顶开了个小菜园。来自不同国家的同学轮流浇水，种上家乡的蔬菜，周五一起摘菜做饭。读完你能用一般过去时和现在完成时介绍一个集体活动。
body: Last spring, students in our hall started a small garden on the roof. At first, there were only six empty boxes and a few bags of soil. Now there are tomatoes, beans, herbs and lots of flowers. Students from many countries help in the garden. Everyone waters the plants on a different day. There is a list on the door, so nobody forgets. Some students have planted vegetables from their home countries. Ji-woo grows a kind of Korean lettuce, and Marco grows his grandmother's basil. On Friday evenings, we pick vegetables and cook dinner together in the kitchen downstairs. It is a great way to meet new people. Last week, twenty students came to dinner! If you live in the hall, you are welcome to join. You don't need any experience, just bring a smile.

speaking: 用 1 分钟介绍你参加过的一个集体活动（社团、志愿者、班级活动）：什么时候开始的、大家一起做什么。用上 at first 和 a great way to。
writing: 用 50–70 词写一则小启事，邀请同学参加一个活动，说明时间、地点和要做什么。至少用一个 If you… 句子。
